label: Recreate table Usuario
summary: Recreates table Usuario to apply schema changes: database/Usuario/column:pin; database/Usuario/column:password

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

precheck.description: ensure temp table "_prisma_new_Usuario" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

precheck.description: ensure table "Usuario" has exactly the columns the rebuild copies or leaves out (activo, createdAt, id, nombre, pin, rol, updatedAt)
precheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('Usuario')) = 7 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('Usuario') WHERE name IN ('activo', 'createdAt', 'id', 'nombre', 'pin', 'rol', 'updatedAt')) = 7

execute.description: create new table "_prisma_new_Usuario" with desired schema
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_Usuario" (
  "activo" INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) NOT NULL,
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "password" TEXT,
  "pin" TEXT,
  "rol" TEXT DEFAULT 'TECNICO' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)
SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

postcheck.description: verify "Usuario" is stored as the rebuilt table
postcheck.sql:
SELECT (SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'Usuario') = 'CREATE TABLE "Usuario" (
  "activo" INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime(''%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ'',''now'')) NOT NULL,
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "password" TEXT,
  "pin" TEXT,
  "rol" TEXT DEFAULT ''TECNICO'' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL
)'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM pragma_table_info('Usuario') WHERE name = 'pin' AND "notnull" = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM pragma_table_info('Usuario') WHERE name = 'password' AND "notnull" = 0
